name: 2 Shot Diary
source:
2 Shot Diary is a collection of twelve short episodes of sexual nature, each told by a different young woman, presented as entries in their diaries. There is no connection between the stories. Each heroine has a different profession and social status (high school student, nurse, model, etc.), where each episode usually centers around a particular sexual theme (voyeurism, lesbian sex, rape, etc.). The game is almost entirely pornographic, with nearly each screen being a depiction of a sexual activity.

Instead of making decisions, as in most visual novels, the player chooses words from a menu to insert into the text. If the choice makes no sense, it simply disappears and the player chooses another one.

[edited from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/2-shot-diary]MobyGames[/url]]
translation:
《2 Shot Diary》是十二个关于性本质的短集的集合，每集都由不同的年轻女性讲述，并作为日记中的条目呈现。故事之间没有任何联系。每个女主角都有不同的职业和社会地位（高中生、护士、模特等），每一集通常围绕特定的性主题（偷窥、女同性恋、强奸等）。这款游戏几乎完全是色情内容，几乎每个屏幕都描绘了性活动。

玩家不像大多数视觉小说那样做出决定，而是从菜单中选择单词插入文本中。如果这个选择没有意义，它就会消失，然后玩家选择另一个。

[编辑自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/2-shot-diary]MobyGames[/url]]
